query: UPDATE discovery_entries SET state='denied',revision=revision+1,title=NULL,summary=NULL,language=NULL,published_at=NULL,sensitive=false,invalidation_reason='missing_indexing_denied',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE kind IN ('post','video') AND state='active' AND (indexable='missing' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM discovery_entries a WHERE a.canonical_uri=discovery_entries.actor_uri AND a.kind='profile' AND a.indexable='missing'))
